title: Cowboy - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: Caleb Marting, Open Sauce 2026 badge add-on 'Cowboy', github.com/calebmarting/os2026-badge (MIT)
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
D1 is the red light in the middle of the sheriff's star: reverse-mount, shining through the board. 1.3 k gives about 1 mA.
The maker's board had a 5 mm through-hole LED there, a 1 k resistor, and a solder jumper 'LED SELECT' (badge VCC or badge GPIO2).
That jumper is gone: the switch chooses the supply, and GPIO2 is left unconnected.
